title: Surreal Fairy Sorceress
description: A central female figure with large golden butterfly wings stands in a vibrant surreal dreamscape, wearing a blue and silver geometric armored bodice and holding a glowing blue crystal hammer. She is surrounded by melting clocks, floating eyeballs, jellyfish-like creatures, apples, stone ruins, and a framed painting of a dark castle under a crescent moon.
prompt: A beautiful young woman with golden butterfly wings and a flower crown stands at the center of a surreal dream world, wearing a blue long-sleeved armored bodice with glowing blue crystal patterns and silver scale armor. She raises one hand while holding a large ornate hammer with a glowing blue crystal head. The scene is filled with melting clocks draped over stone steps, floating eyeballs, green jellyfish creatures, red apples, ancient stone ruins with white drapery, and a large ornate mirror frame showing a dark gothic castle at night, dramatic cinematic lighting with orange and teal color palette, highly detailed surreal fantasy artwork
